author: Junr
body:
Hello, I am Junr, I am looking for a new team. I am currently on Ice Cucumbers and planning to leave once I find a more organized team. Currently, my team reserves a scrim server, but no one else goes on it. Also, no one has no contact with me and I don't have contact with them and only have contact in game. Here are my statistics:
-12k+ Kills
-  I'm an ok pvper.
- I like to rush and defend, but prefer to defend
- I have TS and Skype. (I will give my skype for whoever would like me on their team)
- I am online everyday for about 1-2 hours on Weekdays and 3-4 hours on Weekends, unless if I am gone on a trip.
- PVP KD 0.85 :/, KD 0.75 :/

Thank you for your considerations, on April 30th, I will post what team that I joined. Have a fantastic day!
